content: Table TABREF36 shows that the quality of the model trained on data which came from the parallel part is worse than the one trained on monolingual data. This indicates that requiring each sentence in a group to have a reliable translation changes the distribution of the data, which might be not beneficial for translation quality and provides extra motivation for using monolingual data.
